name: DeezNutz404
summary: DN404Reflect._transfer() snapshots the sender and recipient reflection balances, then writes them through two storage references without rejecting from == to. On a self-transfer both references alias the same account, so the recipient credit overwrites the sender debit and inflates the balance; the attacker repeated this before selling the unbacked tokens into the WETH pair.
notes: The top-level CREATE installed the direct 10,992-byte DeezNutz runtime containing the defective DN404Reflect transfer path; its runtime hash is unchanged immediately before the exploit.

Gross victim depletion is the exact WETH balance decrease of the DeezNutz/WETH pair 0x1fb4904b26de8c043959201a63b4b23c414251e2, from 59.087960396039603932 WETH immediately before the transaction to 0.442623371324096092 WETH afterward. The 2,000 WETH Balancer flash principal and 1 WETH fee were repaid and do not reduce the pool's loss. CoinGecko's last ETH observation before the transaction values the 58.64533702471550784 WETH at $169,979.60.
